items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Dick Hyde. Don Rader, Bobby Shuf, let's see, who else. Oh, it was just a great band, it was just a fun band.

ctx.x: Yes, yes. Dick Hyde. Don Rader, Bobby Shuf, let's see, who else. Oh, it was just a great band, it was just a fun band. So as I say I got quite a bit of exposure after that. Then I got the yen to teach again, so I got this studio and I've been teaching two days a week every -- ever since. Now, my students will come -- I just had a student last week to come from Boston to study with me. I had a student to come from Montana, to study with me. I have students come from San Francisco to study with me. You know. So…
Now, this is gratifying, you know. So I'm beginning to write a few things for guitar now.
